observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Iugnay si Dina sa kasalukuyang prenatal service, alamin ang anumang concern na kailangang madaliin, at ayusin ang follow-up.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Communicates urgency where indicated and refers through the approved pathway.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hintaying malapit na ang panganganak bago magpatingin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Wait until delivery is near before seeking care.
